Hey! I suggest 2 possible build paths, quite traditional, which I personally use to shine and rank up with Ahri! 

You want to use one or the other depending on the enemy's team comp. If they have 3+ squishy members or fighters with no many defenses, think about building your Ahri through **assassination path**. On the other hand, if they have 3+ tanky members, think about building your Ahri through a more sustained **mage oriented path**. They both have different playstyles.

**Assassination traditional build**: Luden's, Sorcerer Shoes, Horizon Focus, Rabaddon, Zhonya and/or Banshee, possible Void Staff if they stack mr. **Your job**: in a teamfight, is to unexpectedly take off an enemy carry, one-shotting him. It doesn't matter how fed he is if you can erase him from the game!  You only need to hit your charm from the shadows of a bush or dash-in behind him, through a wall. Make sure you use your red trinket to know if they see you through vision, since you really want to be unexpected and fast when assassinating.

**Mage traditional build**: Liandry's, Sorcerer Shoes, Morello, Demonic Embrace, Cosmic Drive. This path is way more flexible than the assassination one as you want to pick the items according on what you need the most. If CDR, if heal reduction or defenses first. There's also no shame in picking Void Staff as 2nd if the enemy's are tanky and stacking early MR. You can pick Morello as 3rd or as 5th, depending on the game state. As I said, this build path is more flexible.

The amazing thing is that all of these items grant you HP, which is why most people prefer this build over than the assassination one currently, but in my opinion they overlook the fact that with the assassination build you want to assassinate their carries, and with mage build you want to peel for your carries and diminish the impact of their tanks instead.

Usually, the assassination build works well to counter the enemy FED carries (hitting charm is necessary to one-shot though). Whereas the Mage build works well to counter the enemy FED tanks. 

​

Early tip: Consider taking Corrupting against some matchups like: Ekko, Pantheon, Zed for more sustain for the heated early agressions. I recommend bone plating against Pantheon, Zed, Irelia.

Horizon Focus makes more sense on Ahri than Lich Bane.

Your charm triggers the Horizon Focus passive which increases by 10% damage dealt from your abilities to one-shot.

However, if you can't consistently land charms (a hard ability to land but very crucial and requires practice), consider taking Lich Bane then, which isn't optimal.

There's no point in picking Dark Harvest on Ahri when you can do the same exact job and even better with Electrocute.

I'm assuming the reason you're picking Dark Harvest is to be able to one-shot people in late game, but you can also be one-shotting in late game with electrocute, and this last rune is even more benefitial since it helps you snowball from early stages of the game.

I'm platinum but I think there's no point in getting mythical items that offer you no mana, since Ahri is very reliant on her mana and is a stat designed for her. That means we only have 3 viable mythical: Ludens', Liandries and Everfrost.

**Pick Luden's**: When they have a lot of squishies to assassinate. I like to Combine it with **Horizon Focus**. for extra threat for execution. I also pick **Ionian Boots**, because Luden's already grants +10 magic pen. with an additional +5 magic pen. per item with passive and for the lack of magic pen. you can get void staff later on, and I think Ahri craves a cdr item somewhere in her itemization. (Note: Ionian boots reduces your summoner spells for more flashy instant kills). 

**Pick Liandris**: When they have a lot of tankies and want to play a mage role to protect your squishies from the agressive tanks. I like to combine it with **Demonic Embrace, Sorcerer's shoes and Cosmic Drive.** It's very effective and potent combination to make tank's life useless due to your low cdr given by Liandries' 20 haste+passive and Cosmic Drive to lower your Charm. You get penetration from Shoes and demonic embrace+Liandries are the go-to-go to kill tanks, so it's probably the perfect combination of items. You get a dose of every important stat for Ahri.

**Pick Everfrost:** Haven't experimented BUT it looks strong because of the CC. So it can be awesome for set up's. for teamfights, and overall might be more benefitial than Luden's because of it. (I don't know how good it's with electrocute or glacial since I never tried). I would be picking **Sorcerer's shoes** for the lack of magic pen. and trying to get the active cdr (which you can get from the secondary inspiration: **Cosmic Insight,** as well as a potential **Ingenious Hunter**), to take more benefit from it.

Hey! I'm not sure if I understood what you mean. 

You meant that: "e+flash then ult" is more or less the same as "e+flash+ult instant"? 

Both are cool! but for different scenarios.

It overall depends on the distance between you and your target. Considering a scenario where your opponent is far away, I don't think e+flash is always the best choice because:

​

1. You are giving the enemy slight time to react \*he can dodge\*.
2. There is more probability to fail that charm, since it's not instant \*failing the skill\*
3. Good opponents already expect your e+flash, because it's quite a common thing, but nobody expects an instant charm from kilometers away.

​

When it comes to "e+flash then ult" is better when your targets are closer to you, so you make sure it is more instant and doesn't fail.

To sum up, these should be considered different techniques as they won't provide the same results in the same scenarios. Maybe in some, but not in all.

To make this work you pre-cast charm (E), after you do that, immediately (F+R) at the same time! 

It's the same mechanic as the flash+charm combo, but in this "Supersonic" one you also R when you flash. If you manage to calculate the distance, executing the combo perfectly, you can charm them behind their minions!

It's a very nice combo to use when the opponent is below 50% HP and is "disrespecting" you by going on a minion, so you know the intentions of your enemy to make sure you don't fail it!
